description: Crimes and anti-social behaviour recorded by police within 1 mile of an address in the latest published month (data.police.uk, England, Wales and Northern Ireland), by type, with the count within 400 m. Central London falls back to a quarter mile. US: says plainly that no free national crime data by address exists and where to look.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

title: Street crime nearby (UK)
